scripts.dev: npm run build -w @polycompile/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @polycompile/server" "npm run dev -w @polycompile/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @polycompile/shared && npm run build -w @polycompile/server && npm run build -w @polycompile/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @polycompile/shared && npm run typecheck -w @polycompile/server && npm run typecheck -w @polycompile/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w @polycompile/shared && npm run test -w @polycompile/server && npm run test -w @polycompile/client
